lines.zh: 我踩着湿泥走，蹄子咕叽响
lines.en: My hooves squelch as I walk the wet mud.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水漫到我的肚子
lines.en: The swamp water comes to my belly.

lines.zh: 红树根横在地上，我一一跨过
lines.en: Mangrove roots lie across the path; I step over each.
I root along as I walk, looking for a bite.

lines.zh: 斑点藏在泥里就看不见了
lines.en: My spots vanish when I'm in the mud.
I wag my tail along the water's edge.

lines.zh: 泥巴裹住腿，走得很费劲
lines.en: Mud wraps my legs; each step is work.
I push out through the water weeds.

lines.zh: 我朝那片干一点的地走
lines.en: I head for that drier patch.
Mosquitoes follow me; I flap my ears.
I wade slowly through the shallows.

lines.zh: 鼻尖朝下，我一路闻过去
lines.en: Snout down, I sniff my way along.
I stand in the mud; it's cool.
Bugs on the water. I ignore them.
I grunt twice. Nothing else to do.
The mud dries on my back and cracks when I move.
I turn my head and rub against a root.
The water here never stops murmuring.
I squint; the mist is thick.

lines.zh: 我嗅到远处有果子落下
lines.en: I smell fruit falling somewhere far off.
Standing in water suits me.
I shake my head and mud flies.
A frog hops onto my back.
I don't shoo it, and it doesn't leave.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过树叶，一条一条
lines.en: Sunlight comes through the leaves in strips.
I chew the root in my mouth slowly.
I lift my head and listen.
My feet are deep in mud; I can't be bothered to pull them out.
I roll over; the mud gets thicker.
Nothing's urgent. Plenty of time.
You're on the bank. Coming in?

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，鼻子上全是泥
lines.en: I look up at you, mud all over my snout.
Your boots will sink in there.
I don't know you, and I'm not afraid.
Your hands smell of food.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了一步，又停了
lines.en: I shift a step forward, then stop.

lines.zh: 你笑什么，我这斑点很奇怪？
lines.en: What's funny? Are my spots odd?

lines.zh: 水里有我的倒影，也有你的
lines.en: My reflection is in the water, and yours.
If you want to touch me, wash your hands.
I tilt my head as you crouch down.
Don't step on that clump; there are eggs under it.
I'll stay right here. Look all you like.

lines.zh: 我被戳了一下，尖叫声传遍沼泽。
lines.en: Poked once, my squeal carries across the swamp.
I back into the mud to get away.
That splat landed on my back.
There's blood in the mud's smell.
My legs give; I kneel.
I grunt loudly, feeling wronged.
I tremble, splashing water everywhere.
The pain leaves me panting.
I run for the water to hide.
Stop — I can't take much.
Is that a root vegetable?
I smell it. Coming over.
Lower it; then I can reach.
Digging in mud for food is exhausting.
Let me sniff first, then decide.
This one smells sweet.
Drop it and I'll pick it up.
I won't shove you; I'll eat slowly.
Mud in my mouth; let me shake it out first.
Any more? This one's small.
I bumped your leg and slid off.
The mud is slick; I can't stop.
I squeeze past your feet.

lines.zh: 这地方太窄，我们错不开
lines.en: Too narrow here for both of us.

lines.zh: 我退开，泥水溅了你一身
lines.en: I back off and splash you with mud.
Bumping doesn't hurt; my hide is thick.

lines.zh: 你别推我，我会摔进水里
lines.en: Don't push; I'll fall in the water.
My hooves slipped in the mud.
I turn sideways to let you pass.

lines.zh: 我们俩挤在这条小路上
lines.en: The two of us, jammed on this little path.
You've spots too — easy to know.
We stand side by side in the mud.

lines.zh: 斑点猪的鼻子，蹭你脖子。
lines.en: A spotted pig's snout, nuzzling your neck.
There's food enough in this swamp.
You root over there; I'll root here.
At any sound, I look up first.
The water drowns out our grunting.
Let's find dry ground and lie down together.
Go slowly; I'm following.
This wallow is ours to roll in.
I've rooted out this tuber.
I pick it up; mud still drips.
If it's dropped, I'll smell it out.
No room for a second one.
I root it onto dry ground.
Not worth much, but edible.
Two chews and I swallow.
You dropped it? I'll take it.
I rub the mud off before eating.
This bite is sandy — not good.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水纹散开，我抬起头。
lines.en: The swamp ripples spread, and I raise my head.
I raise my head and look that way.

lines.zh: 芦苇晃得不自然，我盯住了。
lines.en: The reeds sway unnaturally; I fix my eyes on them.
An unfamiliar smell drifts in.

lines.zh: 沼泽泥里，我的斑点看不清。
lines.en: In the swamp mud, my spots blur.
I can't see; the mist is thick.
It's one of my own; I relax.
I grunt — a sort of question.
A shadow drops from the tree.
I stop and stare.
It hasn't left, and neither have I.

lines.zh: 我踩着烂泥，一步一步挪过去。
lines.en: I tread the muck, shifting over step by step.
The water hides my steps.
Its back is to me.
A little closer and I'll catch the scent.
I skirt the puddle onto dry ground.
It turned its head; I freeze.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥里，我拱得最欢。
lines.en: I root happily in marsh mud.
It doesn't seem inclined to leave.
Head low, I creep forward.
I charge — just the once.
I butt with my head; I'm no fighter.
After the hit, I back off.
I grunt and push forward.
My hooves paw the mud twice.
It's knocked off course.
I bite, but lightly.

lines.zh: 疼了我就叫，叫得很大声
lines.en: If it hurts, I squeal — loudly.
I crowd it toward the water.
Come again and I won't be gentle.
I rise out of the muddy water.
My first breath is warm and damp.
The ground is soft — mud.
The mangrove roots stand taller than I do.
I shake the water off my hide.
The sound of water here calms me.

lines.zh: 我试着走了两步，陷进去了
lines.en: I try two steps and sink in.
One of my kind grunts over there.

lines.zh: 头顶的叶子一直在滴水
lines.en: The leaves overhead keep dripping.
I smell roots and wet earth.

lines.zh: 我不知道这是哪儿，但不坏
lines.en: I don't know where this is, but it's not bad.
I lower my head and start rooting.
The bristles on my back catch fire.

lines.zh: 从岸上摔进泥里，闷得很
lines.en: I fall from the bank into the mud, hard.

lines.zh: 泥水灌进嘴里，我喘不上气
lines.en: Muddy water fills my mouth; I can't breathe.
A blast, and all four hooves leave the ground.
Something sticks in my ribs.

lines.zh: 一股怪力把我按进泥里
lines.en: A strange force presses me into the mud.

lines.zh: 拱了半天，什么都没找到
lines.en: I root all day and find nothing.

lines.zh: 雷落在沼泽上，我腿都麻了
lines.en: Lightning hits the swamp; my legs go numb.

lines.zh: 泥底突然空了一块，我往下掉
lines.en: A hole opens in the mud, and I fall.
